exposure: epidural analgesia with ropivacaine 0.2% with fentanyl 2mcg/ml
epidural analgesia with levobupivacaine 0.2% with fentanyl 2mcg/ml
cohort: The study included 200 parturients in active labor.
finding: Epidural analgesia with ropivacaine-fentanyl provided superior pain relief and faster onset compared to levobupivacaine-fentanyl, while neonatal outcomes slightly favored levobupivacaine-fentanyl.
mod_finding: No significant differences were observed in the mode of delivery between the ropivacaine-fentanyl and levobupivacaine-fentanyl epidural regimens.
